_comment: Copy to crawler/config.json and edit. Paths may be absolute, relative to the synced OneDrive folder, %ENV% expanded, a OneDrive/SharePoint sharing link, or graph:/path-in-my-OneDrive.

graph._comment: Only needed when the crawler runs on a machine without the OneDrive sync client. Register an app in Entra ID (Mobile/desktop, redirect https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient, Allow public client flows = Yes, delegated permission Files.ReadWrite).

knownItems._comment: Graph ids for the Inwork report found on OneDrive, for graph:drives/{driveId}/items/{itemId} style sources.
